name: Aberrant Disciple
body:
Those who were contaminated by incomprehensible forces, either through an eldritch ritual, a mixing of blood, or a horrific experience, can learn to use their taint for fun or profit.

Requirements

To qualify to become an aberrant disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Any non-aberration.
Skills: Knowledge (dungeoneering) 5 ranks.
Languages: Aklo.
Spellcasting: Able to spontaneously cast 1st-level arcane spells. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the aberrant bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the aberrant bloodline.
Class Skills

The aberrant disciple’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Escape Artist (Dex), Fly (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (any) (Int), Perception (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Stealth (Dex).

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d8.

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the aberrant disciple prestige class.

Table 5: Aberrant Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Alien ascendance, detect aberration, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Con +2), bloodline feat, eldritch attack	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Aberrant body (1/day), unusual anatomy	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Con +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, darkvision 30 ft.	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Dex +2)	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Aberrant body (2/day), natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Int +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Alien resistance	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
10th	+7	+5	+3	+5	Aberrant body (3/day), darkvision 60 ft.	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class
Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Aberrant disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, an aberrant disciple gains new spells per day as if he had also gained a level in an arcane spellcasting class he belonged to before adding the prestige class. He does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if he is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming an aberrant disciple, he must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Alien Ascendance: An aberrant disciple adds his level to his sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from his bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with his aberrant disciple levels to determine his bloodline powers. If he does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, he instead gains bloodline powers of the aberrant sorcerer bloodline, using his aberrant disciple level as his sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained.

This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless he possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Detect Aberration (Su)

An aberrant disciple can detect aberration at will, as the spell. If the aberrant disciple already possesses this ability, its range doubles instead.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, an aberrant disciple gains an alien protection from attacks, causing a cumulative increase to his natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As his body becomes more and more a vessel for otherworldly forces, an aberrant disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 5: Aberrant Disciple. These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, an aberrant disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from the sorcerer aberrant bloodline’s bonus feat list or from the bloodrager aberrant bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one he is advancing with his level progression.

Eldritch Attack: At 2nd level, an aberrant disciple doubles his sorcerer or bloodrager level for the purpose of using his first-level bloodline power.

Aberrant Body (Sp)

At 3rd level, an aberrant disciple’s warped blood grants him the ability to assume the shape of a true aberration once per day. This ability works like aberrant form I. At 7th level, this ability functions as aberrant form II and can be used twice per day; at 10th level, it functions as aberrant form III and the aberrant disciple can use this ability three times per day. His caster level for this effect is equal to his effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for his aberrant bloodline.

Unusual Anatomy (Su)

At 3rd level, an aberrant disciple gains the unusual anatomy bloodline power, even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the aberrant disciple’s chance to ignore any critical hit or sneak attack scored against him increases by 25%.

Darkvision (Ex)

At 5th level, the aberrant disciple gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If he already possessed darkvision, the ability range increases by 30 feet instead. At 10th level, the aberrant disciple adds another 30 feet to his darkvision range.

Alien Resistance (Su)

At 9th level, an aberrant disciple gains the alien resistance power of the aberrant sorcerer bloodline or the aberrant resistance power of the aberrant bloodrager bloodline (depending on which one he is advancing with his level progression), even if he doesn’t normally possess that power. Once his level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, an aberrant disciple that already possesses alien resistance also gains aberrant resistance (constantly); if he instead possesses aberrant resistance, he also gains alien resistance (while bloodraging).
